name: retired_rankings
description: Ranking maps the game later replaced with "+" versions, playable again from one Campaign tab entry.
_comment: Ranking maps that a later "+" version replaced in the event archives, listed together as one Campaign tab entry. Each map keeps its id, so the server's rules for it (score, supply line) still apply. Maps: Down the Rabbit Hole (10017), Imaginary Maze (10036), Hornet's Nest (10091), Hurricane Rescue (10155), Reign of Chaos (10253, 10273), Flowers of the End and EX (10342, 10365), Escape Acceleration EX-I and Labyrinthine Defense (10417, 10418), Vortex of Secrets, Tide of Blood and Trap of Espionage (10520-10522), Scorpion Vortex and Operation Mistbuster (10674, 10675), City of Nightmares (10800).

campaign.name: Retired Rankings
campaign.description: Ranking maps from past events that the game replaced with their "+" versions.
